m1.typescript: m1 a run alternates model and tools until the model ends its turn

e1.typescript: e1 the stop reason decides and the words of the text do not

e2.typescript: e2 every call of a turn is answered in one user message in order

e3.typescript: e3 a failing or unknown tool becomes an error result and the run goes on

e4.typescript: e4 the turn limit is a backstop that ends only a run the model has not ended

e5.typescript: e5 a cut off or refused reply ends the run with its own status

e6.typescript: e6 a tool use reply without a tool call is malformed and sends nothing more

wrong-text-marker.defect: ends the run when the text says done, even if the reply also calls a tool

wrong-cap-reports-done.defect: reports a run that hit the turn limit as done

wrong-cap-off-by-one.defect: allows one model call more than the turn limit

wrong-results-split.defect: answers each tool call of a turn in its own user message

wrong-error-without-flag.defect: sends a failing tool's message back as an ordinary result

wrong-truncated-is-done.defect: treats a reply cut off by max_tokens as a finished one

wrong-malformed-continues.defect: sends an empty user message and calls the model again after a tool use reply with no call
